vb_textbox.text: During the game you will be shown fixed pairs of gnomes: orange & brown, green & pink, red & yellow and blue & purple. In each pair, one of the gnomes will take you too a light forest and the other to a dark forest. The number of mushrooms in each forest will change each round. You will need to figure out which forest has the most mushrooms in it and aim to chose the correct colored gnome to take you to the forest you want. The most important thing to remember is if you want to go to the light forest you need to pick the orange, red, blue and green gnomes.For the dark forest you need to pick the yellow, purple, brown and pink gnomes.The gnomes appearance does changed throughout but focus on their colour and not their appearance. Also each round will have a multiplier (x1 or x5) meaning some rounds are more important to get the highest score you can.Good luck!
